messages:
Priya: handing off now — quick concise summary for the night shift (03:01 UTC). Short version: embeddings autoscaler in eu-west entered a rapid upscaling loop after a control-plane retry spike; we saw elevated 503s for small requests from 02:10–02:45, incident opened (INC-2026-0412), mitigated, and closed at 03:05. No data loss, no auth issues. Primary->Secondary: Ethan is primary for the next 8h, Marta covers EU-specific followups. Sam is on standby for infra-level rollbacks.

Priya: customer impact — ~4% of small-embedding requests (<=128 tokens) returned 503 during window. A handful of PLG users saw degraded UX; no enterprise SLA violations observed but we should watch p95 token latency.

incident-bot: [03:12 UTC] Pager raised: INC-2026-0412 — eu-west embeddings autoscaler thrash. Pages: @pri, @oncall-eu.

Ethan: ack. Thanks. Is there an immediate mitigation I should leave in place?

Priya: mitigation applied was conservative autoscale lock (reduced aggressive upscales) + temporary instance drain of the offending host pool. Commands used:```bash
rwdctl autoscaler set eu-west --policy conservative
rwdctl pool drain eu-west-pool-7 --wait 30s
```Don't remove the lock unless we see steady p95 < 600ms for 30m.

Marta: saw the same in dashboards. I ran a quick query against trace service and saw high retry counts from model-server-proxy v1.12. Suggest we open a followup for proxy PCR. Ticket: TKT-6482.

Priya: noted — opened TKT-6482 and added logs + heap snapshots. Followups for morning: (1) proxy PCR investigation, (2) autoscaler policy review (thresholds and cooldowns), (3) add a short-circuit for tiny embeddings to use cached path.

Sam: can you paste the exact query you used for retries so I can reproduce in the log-agg?

Marta: sure — run in the log UI: `service:model-server-proxy source:eu-west @level:WARN | json.retry_count:>3 | stats count() by host` Should match hosts flagged in the pool drain.

Priya: current status: stable. No active pages. Autoscaler lock still in place. Customer-facing monitors green except residual p95 bump ~5% above baseline.

Ethan: got it. I'll own immediate monitoring and will escalate if we see new pagers. My quick checklist for next 2h: verify p95 trend for 30m windows, confirm no further autoscaler cycles, ensure drain completed cleanly.

Priya: handoff notes for you (Ethan) — runbook refs below. Runbook excerpt for quick rollback is in the runbook page; copy-paste for ease:```text
If embeddings autoscaler thrashes:
1) Set autoscaler to conservative: `rwdctl autoscaler set <region> --policy conservative`
2) Identify host pool with high retries and drain: `rwdctl pool drain <pool>`
3) Mark pool unschedulable in k8s if necessary.
4) Notify product if >10% customers affected.
```Link: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/autoscaler-thrash (internal)

Ethan: thanks — can you also call out which dashboards to watch?

Priya: dashboards: "Embeddings: p95 token latency (per-region)", "Autoscaler events (per-region)", "Model-proxy retries". Short links: https://obs.redwood/d/emb-p95, https://obs.redwood/d/autoscaler, https://obs.redwood/d/proxy-retry.

devops-bot: [03:20 UTC] Pool eu-west-pool-7 drain completed (30s wait). Instances removed: i-0a1b2c3d, i-0d3c2b1a.

Marta: I left a note in TKT-6482 with heap snapshots and the trace links. Will follow up in the morning with targeted regression tests.

Ethan: acknowledged. For the public-facing followup: do we want to send a short status note to affected PLG customers or wait until the proxy PCR is clearer?

Priya: quick comms recommended — short apology + note that issue was mitigated and we are doing a root-cause follow-up. I can draft a 1-paragraph blurb if you want me to. Keep it light; don't call out internal details.

Ethan: please draft and DM me; I'll publish to outreach channel if okay.

Priya: will draft and send to you within 20m.

Marta: one more technical follow-up — the node metrics show a memory bump on model-server-proxy v1.12; if we see repetition after autoscaler unlock, escalate to infra with heap dump.

Ethan: noted. Passing primary to me now. Marta remains secondary for eu-specific. Sam on infra standby. Priya — thanks for the detailed notes.

Priya: all set. Quick recap for whoever picks this up: incident INC-2026-0412 — eu-west embeddings autoscaler thrash, mitigated via conservative autoscaler lock + pool drain, closed at 03:05, followups: TKT-6482 (proxy PCR), autoscaler policy tuning, cached-path small-embeddings feature. No SLA breach.

Ethan: closing the thread on my side unless we get new pages. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: [03:25 UTC] Incident INC-2026-0412 marked resolved by Priya.

Priya: handing off — ping if anything new. Good night.
